medicineFormulary.name: Augmentin 625mg (Amoxicillin + Clavulanate)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Take after meals with plenty of water. Complete full course.

medicineFormulary.name: Amoxicillin 500mg
medicineFormulary.instructions: Take after meals. Inform doctor immediately if any rash or allergy occurs.

medicineFormulary.name: Metrogyl 400mg (Metronidazole)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Take strictly after meals. Strictly avoid alcohol during treatment.

medicineFormulary.name: Zerodol-SP (Aceclofenac + Paracetamol + Serratiopeptidase)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Take after food. Relieves pain and post-op swelling.

medicineFormulary.name: Ketorol DT (Ketorolac Tromethamine 10mg)
medicineFormulary.frequency: 1 tablet SOS (as needed for severe pain)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Disperse in half a cup of water. Maximum 40mg per 24 hours.

medicineFormulary.name: Pantocid 40mg (Pantoprazole)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Take 30 minutes before breakfast on an empty stomach.

medicineFormulary.name: Hexidine Mouthwash (0.2% Chlorhexidine Gluconate)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Swish vigorously for 1 minute then spit out. Do not rinse with water or eat for 30 minutes.

medicineFormulary.name: Kenacort 0.1% Oral Paste (Triamcinolone Acetonide)
medicineFormulary.instructions: Dab gently over oral ulcer/aphthae. Do not rub.
